name: bash
purpose: Invoke the Bourne-Again Shell interpreter to run shell commands or scripts.
explanation: Used in C03 (`bash -c "$(curl -fsSL ...)"`) to install Homebrew and in C07 (`#!/bin/bash`) as the script interpreter specified by the shebang.

parameters.description: Executes commands read from the provided string.

explanationOfOutput: Executes each line of `hello.sh` sequentially using the `bash` interpreter.
whenToUse: To run shell scripts explicitly or execute a command string in Bash.
commonMistakes: Confusing `bash script.sh` (interpreter reads file) with `./script.sh` (requires `+x` permission and shebang).
commonErrors: bash: script.sh: No such file or directory
